packageRules.description: Expo SDK packages move together; group them so partial bumps never break the SDK pairing

Expo SDK owns these: react and the react-native native modules are pinned to what the managed SDK expects, and move ONLY via `expo install` on an SDK bump, never independently. An independent bump diverges from the SDK and can break native pairing, and expo-doctor (which would catch it) is advisory in CI, so a green build is misleading (decided during the W1 audit, 2026-07-26).

Toolchain: MAJOR bumps follow the Expo SDK (jest / TypeScript / @types) or an explicit decision (eslint 9, see W0.5); node stays on the latest stable within its current major. Non-major bumps flow normally.
